Nom sous lequel circule un immense corpu: Name under which a vast body of Arabic alchemy circulated.
Médecin et alchimiste persan. Il classe: Persian physician and alchemist. He classified substances and told smallpox from measles.
Lettré taoïste. Son Baopuzi décrit les é: Daoist scholar. His Baopuzi described elixirs of immortality.
Médecin suisse. Il veut que l'alchimie f: Swiss physician. He wanted alchemy to make remedies rather than gold.
Savant irlandais. The Sceptical Chymist: Irish scientist. The Sceptical Chymist (1661) demanded experiments, not dogma.
Chimiste anglais. Chaque élément, dit-il: English chemist. Each element, he said, is made of atoms of its own weight.
Chimiste suédois. Il invente la dynamite: Swedish chemist. He invented dynamite and left his fortune to the Nobel Prizes.
